notes.aggregation: Median of per-run statistics. Four component trials per side; two whole-system boots per side, five rounds per boot. All valid samples retained.
notes.cpu: One-shot programs use waited child CPU. Concurrent clients use a single common outer daemon interval.
notes.memory: RSS is not PSS/USS. Whole-system MemAvailable includes the identity-check page cache.
notes.identity_reuse: uci and reload-config rows are the R86 measurements of byte-identical binaries.
